signature: SUBROUTINE DPBSV( UPLO, N, KD, NRHS, AB, LDAB, B, LDB, INFO )

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of A is stored;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of A is stored.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of linear equations, i.e., the order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: kd
params.reference: The number of superdiagonals of the matrix A if `UPLO = 'U'`, or the number of subdiagonals if `UPLO = 'L'`. $\mathrm{KD} \ge 0$.

params.name: nrhs
params.reference: The number of right hand sides, i.e., the number of columns of the matrix B. $\mathrm{NRHS} \ge 0$.

params.name: AB
params.reference:
On entry, the upper or lower triangle of the symmetric band matrix A, stored in the first `KD`+1 rows of the array. The j-th column of A is stored in the j-th column of the array `AB` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AB(KD+1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-\mathrm{KD}) \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AB(1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le \min (N,j+\mathrm{KD})$. See below for further details.

On exit, if `INFO = 0`, the triangular factor U or L from the Cholesky factorization $A = U^T \, U$ or $A = L \, L^T$ of the band matrix A, in the same storage format as A.

params.name: ldab
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AB`. $\mathrm{LDAB} \ge \mathrm{KD}+1$.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the N-by-`NRHS` right hand side matrix B. On exit, if `INFO = 0`, the N-by-`NRHS` solution matrix X.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = i`, the leading principal minor of order i of A is not positive, so the factorization could not be completed, and the solution has not been computed.
